concerns.text: Task T011a references an unresolved claim (c_ab894daa) and lacks concrete details on the Prolific (or alternative) API integration, making the implementation non‑deterministic.

Performance test T061 specifies a 30 s limit for processing 10 1080p images but does not provide the required hardware profile (CPU model, core count) or baseline runtime, so the verification test cannot be reliably executed.
RAM test T061b similarly lacks concrete RAM limit specifications and hardware context, rendering the test ambiguous.

Task T032 (fetch real meeting clips) does not record the dataset version, source URL, or checksum in a persistent artifact, violating Constitution Principle IV (single source of truth) and leaving the task without a verifiable deliverable.

Task T032b (verify clips & record source) mentions recording dataset URL and version ID in research.md, but the verification test only checks a metadata file; the artifact linking the version to the data is missing.
Task T032c creates a curated clips CSV but does not capture provenance (e.g., which version of the source dataset was used), again missing a verifiable artifact per the constitution.

Task T048a references sub‑tasks T048a1‑T048a4 which are not defined anywhere, making the orchestrator task too coarse and under‑specified; it needs decomposition or explicit definitions of the sub‑tasks.
Task T048b depends on T048a’s successful exit and artifact generation, but because T048a is under‑specified, T048b’s verification cannot be reliably performed.

Directory‑creation tasks T001a/T001b have verification tests but lack explicit traceability to any functional requirement (e.g., FR‑001). While executable, adding traceability tags would improve verifiability.
